overview: Finland is a country in northern Europe, between Sweden and Russia. Its capital and largest city is Helsinki. Finland was part of Sweden for centuries and then part of the Russian Empire, before becoming independent in 1917. Finnish and Swedish are both official languages. Finland joined the European Union in 1995 and NATO in 2023.

geography.text: Finland is often called the land of a thousand lakes, but it actually has many tens of thousands. Forests cover around three-quarters of the country. The land is mostly low and gently rolling, shaped by ice sheets during the last Ice Age. The north lies within the Arctic Circle, in Lapland, where the sun does not set for weeks in midsummer.
